novel_features.name: Note profile search & overlap
novel_features.description: Find perfumes matching specific Top/Heart/Base notes (with exclude).
novel_features.rationale: Requires local parsed note sets + set operations across the whole catalog that only our SQLite store provides after sync.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Website faceted search is weak on note combinations; this is the main reason power users will install the CLI.

novel_features.name: Similarity to another perfume
novel_features.description: List perfumes with overlapping note profiles to a given one.
novel_features.rationale: Local Jaccard/overlap on the three parsed note lists is only possible with the full structured catalog in SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents and users want 'more like this but cheaper or fresher' — the site has no equivalent.

novel_features.name: Value / price-per-ml ranking
novel_features.description: Rank current stock by price per ml (or per 100ml) with filters.
novel_features.rationale: Needs price + size normalized across variants + live sync; website never surfaces this computation for arbitrary note/brand slices.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Real NZ buyers care about value; this turns the catalog into a shopping optimizer.

novel_features.name: Trending notes in current stock
novel_features.description: Show the most common notes across in-stock items (overall or filtered).
novel_features.rationale: Aggregate over the parsed note fields from the synced catalog — data that only exists together locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: See what accords are actually available right now from an authentic NZ source.

novel_features.name: Discovery set / recommendation
novel_features.description: Build a small set of perfumes that together cover requested notes under a budget.
novel_features.rationale: Coverage + knapsack over the local store with price and note vectors — impossible on the web UI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The killer workflow: 'give me a 5-perfume discovery box that hits these notes without breaking the bank'.

narrative.headline: The full authentic Perfume NZ catalog, with powerful note-based search and offline intelligence no website offers.
narrative.value_prop: Perfume NZ (perfumenz.co.nz) is New Zealand's largest wholesale distributor of genuine designer and niche fragrances. This CLI syncs their public catalog into a local SQLite store with parsed Top/Heart/Base notes, then gives you filters, FTS, and novel features (note overlap, similarity, price-per-ml, discovery sets) that the Shopify frontend simply cannot provide.

quickstart.comment: Verify the public catalog JSON is reachable (no key needed).
Pull the current ~250 authentic items (brands, prices, explicit notes) into the local store.
Find matching perfumes with structured note filters + machine output.
Discover similar profiles using local note overlap (the feature the website is missing).

troubleshoots.fix: The public /products.json may be paginated or the 'all' collection limited; raise --limit or hit the products endpoint directly in a future sync.
The Fragrance Notes section lives in body_html as 'Top Notes: ... Heart Notes: ... Base Notes: ...'. The parser may need a tweak for this store's exact HTML; check a raw product in the store.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you want to treat the Perfume NZ catalog as a queryable database: complex note combinations, value comparisons, similarity, building discovery sets, or scripting/agents that need structured fragrance data offline.
anti_triggers: real-time cart/checkout (the CLI is read + local cache only)
looking for official brand APIs or wholesale portals (this is the public retail face)
